# Province scope, scope:holder must be the holder of the barony.
# Goes down the priority list. Each missing building the holder could build here
# by hand (all of its first level's requirements, copied from the game) is built
# at level 1 in a free slot; when no slot is free, the worst-ranked building below
# it is removed to make room. No slot is ever added. The upgrade effect then takes
# it as high as its requirements allow.
mqa_b_priority_fill_province_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_building_or_higher = ramparts_01 }
			building_ramparts_requirement_terrain = yes
			building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }
			building_requirement_tribal = no
		}
		if = {
			limit = { free_building_slots < 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = megalith_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_megalith_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = powder_magazine_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_powder_magazine_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = sacred_pool_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_sacred_pool_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = scriptorium_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_scriptorium_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = smiths_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_smiths_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = waterworks_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_waterworks_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = stilted_granaries_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_stilted_granaries_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = market_villages_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_market_villages_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = quarries_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_quarries_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = qanats_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_qanats_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = plantations_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_plantations_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = monastic_schools_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_monastic_schools_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = hospices_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_hospices_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = breweries_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_breweries_effect = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { has_building_or_higher = workshops_01 }
				mqa_b_remove_workshops_effect = yes
			}

# Character scope (the domicile owner). Cancels the domicile's ongoing construction, with
# the game's own refund, so that its slot can be filled and upgraded right away.
mqa_b_cancel_domicile_construction_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { domicile ?= { has_ongoing_domicile_construction = yes } }
		domicile = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = accolade_yurt_01 }
				remove_domicile_building = accolade_yurt_01
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = accolade_yurt_02 }
				remove_domicile_building = accolade_yurt_02
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = accolade_yurt_03 }
				remove_domicile_building = accolade_yurt_03
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = accolade_yurt_04 }
				remove_domicile_building = accolade_yurt_04
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = accolade_yurt_05 }
				remove_domicile_building = accolade_yurt_05
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = accolade_yurt_06 }
				remove_domicile_building = accolade_yurt_06
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = agent_dread_yurt_01 }
				remove_domicile_building = agent_dread_yurt_01
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = agent_dread_yurt_02 }
				remove_domicile_building = agent_dread_yurt_02
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = agent_dread_yurt_03 }
				remove_domicile_building = agent_dread_yurt_03
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = agent_dread_yurt_04 }
				remove_domicile_building = agent_dread_yurt_04
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = agent_dread_yurt_05 }
				remove_domicile_building = agent_dread_yurt_05
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = agent_dread_yurt_06 }
				remove_domicile_building = agent_dread_yurt_06
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_domicile_construction = archives_bindery_01 }
				remove_domicile_building = archives_bindery_01

# Character scope (the domicile owner). Builds missing buildings in free slots, by priority:
# buildings with army bonuses first, then gold and resources, then the rest. External
# buildings go in the domicile's external slots, internal ones in the internal slots of their
# parent building. Each building is only attempted when the character meets its own
# can_construct, copied from the game.
mqa_b_construct_domicile_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { domicile ?= { is_domicile_type = camp } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				domicile ?= {
					free_external_domicile_building_slots >= 1
					NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = camp_fire_01 }
				}
			}
			domicile = { add_domicile_building = camp_fire_01 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				domicile ?= {
					free_external_domicile_building_slots >= 1
					NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = proving_grounds_01 }
				}
			}
			domicile = { add_domicile_building = proving_grounds_01 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				domicile ?= {
					free_external_domicile_building_slots >= 1
					NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = baggage_train_01 }
				}
			}
			domicile = { add_domicile_building = baggage_train_01 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				domicile ?= {
					free_external_domicile_building_slots >= 1
					NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = supply_tent_01 }
				}
			}
			domicile = { add_domicile_building = supply_tent_01 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				domicile ?= {
					free_external_domicile_building_slots >= 1
					NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = mess_tent_01 }
				}
			}
			domicile = { add_domicile_building = mess_tent_01 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				domicile ?= {
					free_external_domicile_building_slots >= 1
					NOT = { has_domicile_building_or_higher = barber_tent_01 }
				}
			}
			domicile = { add_domicile_building = barber_tent_01 }
